description: Asks the result and inner VarType/TypeName of the C* conversions at their range edges and from other types: CLng, CInt and CByte at and one past their limits, CInt and CLng of True, Null and a Date, CCur at and past its limits, CSng at the largest and smallest magnitudes and a denormal, CDbl(CSng(0.1)), CDec at its largest literal and past it, CDec of Boolean and Currency. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
